answer: New identities earn trust from the interaction graph: random walks from verified seeds rank identities, and a sybil cluster sits far from the honest core, so its members score near zero and anchor nothing. Until a score passes 0.6 after 30 days of trades, it pays 5x the payout fee. Each extra fake must forge genuine links to honest members — slow work, each signed like a quill — or pay the 5x fee forever, so 100 fakes cost 500 times the honest price. Graph and scores sit on-chain; any verifier replays the walks, feels the pulse of real activity, and no fake skips the ranking.
